name: Enami Tasuku
source:
The manager of the talent agency Neo belongs to.
He often looks after Neo.
Neo calls him "Ena-chan" and looks up to him like an older brother.

"Huh, nice. Are you interested in modeling or something?"

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=14]official website[/url]]
